## Wave 1 Summary

This wave discharges the single carry-forward `CF-S106-W7-FINER-LMAX-LENGTH-SPECTRUM`, AUGMENTED in place by the S105 GEM-COMMENSURABILITY workshop (spectral-geometer × connes) from a one-gate length re-match into a **three-conjunct substrate-commensurability discriminator**. The physics question: at the fold (τ = 0.19), is the substrate's own squared-action lattice — the set of D_K eigenvalues `E(p,q) = |λ(p,q)|²` indexed by Peter–Weyl sectors — **crystalline (Track A: commensurate / Loeschian-rational `G_E ∝ Hess C₂`, κ = 3)** or **incommensurate (Track B: the Jensen block-splitting `L₁ = e^{2τ}, L₂ = e^{−2τ}, L₃ = e^{τ}` shears the action Hessian, κ drifts from 3)**?

The workshop pinned the structural reduction: squared-action commensurability ⟺ `(G_E/2)⁻¹` ∝ integer matrix ⟺ `G_E` ∝ rational quadratic form ⟺ `s := coeff(pq)/coeff(p²) = 1` (Loeschian), equivalently the anisotropy invariant `A(G_E^{(L)}) = |κ(G_E^{(L)}) − κ(Hess C₂)| = 0`. Because κ of any quadratic form `a(p² + q²) + a·pq` is exactly 3 for every scale `a`, **the commensurability verdict P1 is a single scalar of the energy Hessian — δL-FREE** (no Fourier bin, no Strutinsky width). The DECISIVE AXIS is the **trend of `A(G_E^{(L)})` across L_max ∈ {12, 14, 16}**, not any single value and not the length re-match (routing P1 through the δL-corrupted length functional would be a circularity — both tracks agree it is an unreliable measurement).

**Substrate framing (whole wave; `phononic-framing.md` Level-1 single-τ-slice tag).** The substrate IS the D_K eigenvalue lattice at the fixed τ_fold = 0.19 slice. `E(p,q) = |λ(p,q)|²` and its Hessian `G_E` are intrinsic spectral structure of the spectral triple `(A_K, H_K, D_K(τ_fold))` — they are NOT properties measured IN a geometric container. The commensurability question is about the **fabric's own squared-action lattice geometry**: whether the spectral weight reorganizes onto a crystalline (Loeschian-rational) lattice or onto an incommensurate one as the Jensen deformation block-splits the three SU(3) eigenmode families. The Berry–Tabor length spectrum (1e) is the geometric/length-side image of the same lattice via the trace-formula duality; the level statistics (1b) and the Hessian anisotropy (1a/1d) are two independent substrate-side readings of it. No GR / quantization-in-a-box vocabulary applies — the trace formula is a structural identity on the substrate, not a sum over paths in spacetime.

hypothesis: "The anisotropy invariant A(G_E^{(L)}) = |κ(G_E^{(L)}) − κ(Hess C₂)| (κ=eig_max/eig_min; equivalently |s−1|, s=coeff(pq)/coeff(p²)) computed at a PINNED fit window across L_max ∈ {12,14,16} is FLAT ≈ 0 over the 3 points (Decisive-Track-A: substrate crystalline / Loeschian at fold) iff G_E stays ∝ Hess(C₂), and CLIMBS MONOTONE (Decisive-Track-B: substrate incommensurate) iff the Jensen block-splitting progressively shears the action Hessian as longer-reach sectors enter."

method:
  description: "Consume the L12 fit (from 1a) + the L14/L16 caches (from 1c). At a PINNED fit window (D1 — the fit window is the structural analog of δL; pin it as BOTH (w-all) all sectors at each L AND (w-band) a fixed percentile band of |λ| held constant across L, and report A(G_E) as a function of window), fit E(p,q) = k_diag·(p²+q²) + k_off·(pq) + linear + const at each L_max; form G_E^{(L)}, κ(G_E^{(L)}), s^{(L)}; compute A(G_E^{(L)}) = |κ(G_E^{(L)}) − 3| (κ(Hess C₂)=3 EXACT). Tabulate (L, A, s) for L ∈ {12,14,16} × window ∈ {w-all, w-band}. Classify the TREND: Decisive-Track-A iff A^{(L)} ≤ 0.05 for all L (flat ≈0); Decisive-Track-B iff A^{(L)} strictly increasing with A^{(16)} − A^{(12)} ≥ +0.10 (monotone climb resolved at L16); Ambiguous-middle iff A rising but A^{(16)} < 0.10 OR non-monotone (favors B, not proven). If 1c landed only L14 (INFO), run the 2-point {12,14} trend and disclose the missing L16 point."
  producing_script: "computations/session-106/s106_w1_ge_anisotropy_trend.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set"                              # a trend classification (flat / monotone-climb / ambiguous) over the 3-point A(G_E^{(L)}) sequence
  form: "trend(A^{(12)}, A^{(14)}, A^{(16)}); Decisive-A iff max_L A^{(L)} ≤ 0.05; Decisive-B iff strictly increasing AND A^{(16)} − A^{(12)} ≥ +0.10; else Ambiguous"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "Decisive-Track-A (crystalline) iff A^{(L)} ≤ 0.05 ∀L ∈ {12,14,16} AND |A^{(16)} − A^{(12)}| ≤ 0.05 (flat); Decisive-Track-B (incommensurate) iff A^{(12)} < A^{(14)} < A^{(16)} AND A^{(16)} − A^{(12)} ≥ +0.10 (monotone climb)"
  direction: "<="                          # A^{(L)} <= 0.05 is the flat/crystalline boundary; the >= +0.10 climb is the Track-B boundary

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "κ(Hess C₂) = 3 EXACT (Sage; C₂ quadratic form a(p²+q²)+a·pq has κ=3 ∀a). A=0 is the exact crystalline value, realized at L12 (1a baseline κ=3.0, k_diag=k_off=0.349101 Sage-exact ⇒ A^{(12)}=0). The flat-boundary 0.05 and the climb-boundary 0.10 are tolerance bands around the analytic A=0 anchor; the climb magnitude is set wide enough (0.10) that a resolved monotone trend at L16 is unambiguous. Cited: gem-commensurability-workshop.md structural reduction (s105-w7-WP line 481)."

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true              # A=0 (κ=3, s=1) is the exact rational crystalline target; the trend departs into a continuous band
  mesh_density: "A=0 rational anchor; trend values continuous above; 3-point L mesh {12,14,16}"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "per-L sector counts (90 at L12, ≈105 at L14, ≈136 at L16 for w-all; fixed-percentile band counts for w-band — emitted at runtime)"
  L_max: "[12, 14, 16]"                    # the 3-point trend; degrades to [12,14] if 1c landed only L14
  scan_range: "N/A — discrete L_max set"
  step_size: "N/A — least-squares per L"
  tolerance: "1e-12 lstsq rcond; A flat-band 0.05, climb-band 0.10 per (2)"
  scheme: "QUADRATIC-FORM-LSTSQ-PER-L"     # same fit as 1a, swept over L_max
  convention: "FIT-WINDOW-PINNED-{w-all,w-band}"   # D1 — report A as a function of the window; w-band holds the |λ| percentile band fixed across L
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg-cpu-cap-OMP8"    # design matrices ≤136×6; trivially CPU; cap OMP 8
  publication_precision: "6"               # A, κ, s reported to 6 sig figs per L

audit_discriminators:

substitution_chain:
  required: true

    Definition 1: G_E^{(L)} = Hessian of the quadratic fit to E(p,q)=|λ(p,q)|² on the L_max-truncated sector set at the pinned window. [QUADRATIC-FORM-LSTSQ-PER-L]
    Definition 2: A(G_E^{(L)}) := |κ(G_E^{(L)}) − κ(Hess C₂)| = |κ(G_E^{(L)}) − 3|. [anisotropy invariant; κ(Hess C₂)=3 exact]
    Definition 3: A crystalline (Loeschian) substrate has G_E^{(L)} ∝ Hess(C₂) AT EVERY L ⇒ κ^{(L)} = 3 ⇒ A^{(L)} = 0 ∀L. [Track A]
    Definition 4: An incommensurate substrate has the Jensen block-splitting (L₁=e^{2τ},L₂=e^{−2τ},L₃=e^{τ}) shearing the action Hessian; the shear grows as longer-reach (higher p+q) sectors enter the fit at higher L_max ⇒ κ^{(L)} departs from 3 progressively ⇒ A^{(L)} increases with L. [Track B]
    Substitute: ΔA := A^{(16)} − A^{(12)}. Track A ⇒ ΔA = 0 (A flat at 0). Track B ⇒ ΔA > 0 (A climbs).

    Direction: a flat ΔA≈0 ⇒ substrate crystalline at fold (the L12 length-spectrum FAIL was a pure measurement artifact AND the substrate was crystalline all along); a monotone climb ΔA>0 ⇒ deformation shears the action metric, substrate incommensurate. Routing P1 through the length re-match (1e) would be circular — A(G_E) is δL-FREE and isolates P1.
    Conclusion: the A(G_E^{(L)}) trend direction across {12,14,16} IS the substrate-commensurability verdict P1. [sign_verdict pre-registered: PASS iff computed sign(ΔA) matches whichever track the trend selects; FAIL/INFO per the climb-resolution band]

PASS_meaning: "Decisive-Track-A: A(G_E^{(L)}) ≤ 0.05 flat across {12,14,16} (ΔA ≈ 0). The energy Hessian stays ∝ Hess(C₂) at every truncation ⇒ the substrate's squared-action lattice is Loeschian-rational / CRYSTALLINE at the fold. The decisive δL-free axis resolves P1 to Track A; the S105 L12 length-spectrum FAIL is established as a pure measurement (δL/window) artifact, and the substrate was crystalline all along. Posterior 0.9 to Track A."
FAIL_meaning: "Decisive-Track-B: A(G_E^{(L)}) climbs monotone (A^{(12)}<A^{(14)}<A^{(16)}, ΔA ≥ +0.10). The Jensen block-splitting progressively shears the action Hessian as longer-reach sectors enter ⇒ the substrate's action lattice is INCOMMENSURATE at the fold. A scientific FAIL of the crystalline hypothesis (Track A) — the decisive result; resolves P1 to Track B. Posterior 0.9 to Track B. A valid, informative result, NOT a script failure."
INFO_meaning: "Ambiguous-middle (pre-registered): A is rising but ΔA < 0.10 at L16 (climb not resolved) OR non-monotone OR window-dependent (w-all and w-band disagree on the trend direction). Favors Track B (0.65) but not proven; routes a carry-forward to extend to L18/L20 or to refine the fit window. ## Wave 1 → (Synthesis + downstream) Decision Point

Wave 1 produces no downstream-wave inputs (axis-orthogonal to Waves 2/3/4 per context cross-wave constraint 4). Its output is the **P1 substrate-commensurability verdict** (Track A crystalline vs Track B incommensurate at τ_fold), folded at wave synthesis from the three conjuncts:

| Conjunct | Gate | Decisive weight | Reading |
|:---------|:-----|:----------------|:--------|
| **P1-PRIMARY** (δL-free, decisive) | 1d `GE-ANISOTROPY-TREND` | DECISIVE | A(G_E^{(L)}) trend across {12,14,16}: flat≈0 → A; monotone climb → B; ambiguous → favors B (not proven) |
| P1-PRIMARY sub (L12 cache) | 1a `GE-SUBFIT-KAPPA-DRIFT` | supporting | κ-drift across sector sub-fits: stable κ=3 → A; s_high>1 → B |
| P1-INDEPENDENT (level statistics) | 1b `SFF-UNFOLDING-L12` | independent cross-check | ⟨r⟩: ~0.27 clustered → A; ≈0.386 Poisson → B (in-hand S46 datum 0.439 leans B) |
| P2-ONLY (measurement, reported not folded) | 1e `LENGTH-REMATCH-P2` | NOT folded into P1 | match_frac ≥ 2/3 ∧ robust>0 → length measurement faithful; else still measurement-limited |

**Verdict-folding rule (pre-registered):** P1 is read off the **1d decisive axis**. 1a (L12 sub-fit) and 1b (level statistics) are corroborating/independent readings — concordance with 1d strengthens the verdict; discordance routes a cross-wave reconciliation note (e.g. 1b Track-B but 1d Track-A → flag the level-statistics/Hessian tension). 1e is reported as the P2 measurement-faithfulness status ALONGSIDE P1, never folded into it (the pre-registered circularity guard). 

**Branching on the decisive 1d outcome:**
- **1d PASS (Decisive-Track-A, A flat ≈0):** substrate CRYSTALLINE at fold; the S105 length-spectrum FAIL was a pure measurement artifact (confirmed by 1e if it PASSes). Carry-forward: NONE on P1 (resolved); if 1b is Track-B-discordant, a CF to reconcile level statistics vs Hessian anisotropy.
- **1d FAIL (Decisive-Track-B, monotone climb):** substrate INCOMMENSURATE at fold; the Jensen block-splitting shears the action lattice. Carry-forward: the cosmological/structural consequence of an incommensurate fold (routed to the appropriate reviewer next session, 4-field spec).
- **1d INFO (ambiguous-middle OR only L14 landed):** favors Track B (0.65) but not proven. Carry-forward (4-field): extend the A(G_E) trend to L18/L20 (or complete the L16 point if 1c landed only L14), same fit-window pin, pre-registered same-form trend boundary.

If 1c FAILs, 1d and 1e mechanically close as PRE-REG-INC (`mechanical-closure-discipline.md`) and the P1 verdict rests on the L12-only evidence (1a + 1b), explicitly disclosed as truncation-limited; a carry-forward re-attempts the cache build with a remediated builder.
